name: Imasaka Yue
source: A classmate and childhood friend of [url=/c7877]Tomoya[/url]. Yue is lively and innocent, but gullible as she tends to take things at face value. She gets teased a lot by Tomoya and is surprisingly stubborn in some respects, but she is usually a bundle of optimism. She calls every cat she meets "Neko-pyon."
